subject: Post-call: model parity checklist + next steps for NovaPay evaluation
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Kate Andrews <kate.andrews@novapay.com>, Dylan Chu <dylan.chu@novapay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-02T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: model parity checklist + next steps for NovaPay evaluation

Hi Kate / Dylan 

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on scope and acceptance criteria for the POC.

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary use case: transaction categorization + short-form customer reply generation inside NovaPay merchant dashboard.
- Data: synthetic + historical anonymized transactions (PII redacted) for initial eval (~2k prompts).
- Success criteria: surface-level parity with your current proprietary baseline on intent accuracy and hallucination rate, with production-like latency.

Initial recommendation (what well run):
- Candidate open models to benchmark: llama-3-70b (quantized), mosaic-mpt-30b-instruct, and a trimmed opt-13b variant.
- Redwood baseline for reference: redwood-3b-instruct (our in-house tuned baseline you referenced).
- Prompt set: attached (novapay_prompt_set_v1.jsonl).
- Benchmarks: well run 2k queries through each model and produce a parity matrix (quality, hallucination, 95th-latency).

Acceptance thresholds we'd like you to confirm (suggested):
- Intent accuracy delta <= 2% absolute compared to your baseline.
- Hallucination (false-adds) <= 1.5% absolute.
- 95th percentile latency < 450 ms in hosted-sandbox configuration.

Next steps / owners:
- Redwood runs bench + parity matrix and shares preliminary report (Rishi)  target: 48 hours after we get the sanitized prompt set.
- NovaPay verifies privacy & redaction adequacy and confirms log access scope (Kate)  target: EOD 2026-05-03.
- If parity looks good, schedule a 2-week POC with canary routing and monitoring.

Let me know if you want to tighten or relax any of the suggested thresholds. Ive ccd Rishi and Evelyn for the technical run and the POC plan.

Thanks,
Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: novapay_prompt_set_v1.jsonl (sample prompts, anonymized)

From: Kate Andrews <kate.andrews@novapay.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Chu <dylan.chu@novapay.com>
Date: 2026-05-02T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: model parity checklist + next steps for NovaPay evaluation

Soojin 

Thanks for the clear summary. This aligns with how we see the POC. A couple quick clarifications:
- We can hand over a redacted dataset (same size) by tomorrow morning.
- On thresholds: the intent-accuracy delta <=2% sounds reasonable. For hallucination wed prefer <1% if achievable, otherwise we can agree on a staged target.
- Can you confirm how Redwood will redact logs and what information you need access to during the POC?

Also, please send the benchmark links and any short instructions for us to spin a sandbox if needed.

Kate
Kate Andrews
Head of ML Ops | NovaPay
kate.andrews@novapay.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kate Andrews <kate.andrews@novapay.com>, Dylan Chu <dylan.chu@novapay.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: model parity checklist + next steps for NovaPay evaluation

Kate 

Thanks  and great question on redaction. Quick technical note on how we operate for POCs: 
- Data handling: we accept sanitized files (PII removed). If theres anything borderline, we can run locally within your VPC or a secured sandbox.
- Logs & telemetry: for the parity runs we need request/response pairs and token-level confidence scores. We can receive those as hashed identifiers (no raw card/email fields). We store telemetry in a short-retention workspace for the POC (14 days) unless you instruct otherwise.

Benchmark plan (high level):
1) Run the 2k prompt set against: llama-3-70b (quantized), mosaic-mpt-30b-instruct, opt-13b-trim, redwood-3b-instruct.
2) Metrics: intent accuracy, top-1 label agreement, hallucination incidents (manual adjudication sample), BLEU/ROUGE for reply quality, and 95th/99th latency.
3) Produce a parity matrix and PRD-style notes highlighting failure modes and recommended mitigations (prompt tweaks, temperature, or lightweight finetune).

Deliverables + timeline:
- Preliminary bench CSV + parity matrix (open-model-benchmarks-0502.csv)  48 hours after data receipt.
- Short technical readout + runbook for POC (redwood-parity-matrix-0502.xlsx)  72 hours after data receipt.

One more question: do you have an internal acceptance process for small quality regressions (e.g., temporary tolerance for hallucination while we iterate on prompts)? If so, please share the gatekeepers who would sign off.

Thanks,
Rishi
Principal Applied ML Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachment: open-model-benchmarks-0502.csv

From: Dylan Chu <dylan.chu@novapay.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Kate Andrews <kate.andrews@novapay.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: model parity checklist + next steps for NovaPay evaluation

Rishi / Soojin 

Appreciate the plan. A couple operational notes from our side: 
- We can produce the 2k redacted set by 10:00 AM PT tomorrow.
- For acceptance gates: Im the initial reviewer and will pull in our ML lead (TBD) only if the parity matrix shows mixed signals. Were OK with a staged tolerance on hallucination as long as its documented and we have mitigation steps.
- We will upload the files to the Drive folder you shared; please confirm the run commands youll use and if we should expect any SDK keys.

Thanks,
Dylan
Product Manager | NovaPay

Attachment: (none)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Kate Andrews <kate.andrews@novapay.com>, Dylan Chu <dylan.chu@novapay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: model parity checklist + next steps for NovaPay evaluation

Hi all 

Great  thanks for the quick turnaround. Two quick confirmations from Redwood: 
- We will pull the redacted dataset from the Drive link and run the sandbox using temporary API tokens scoped to the sandbox project. We will share tokens and run commands in a short secure note once youve uploaded the files (no long-lived keys).
- Target deliverables remain the preliminary bench CSV in 48 hours and the readout + runbook in 72 hours after we confirm the dataset.

If the initial parity is within the acceptance windows you approved, Ill send a calendar invite to kick off the 2-week POC with a short technical onboarding session (30 minutes) and a weekly sync. If were outside the window well propose prompt adjustments and a second run.

Thanks again  looking forward to the data.

Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
